input.description: Published content of The Bharat Times.

capabilities.purpose: Published news articles from The Bharat Times. Each article carries its headline, summary, publication time, hero image, and the sections (categories) it appears in. Use for any question about what has been published — latest stories, articles on a topic, coverage in a section. To narrow to one section (Politics, Business, World, Opinion, Culture, Sport), filter on the Sections field with a contains match on the section name; it is narrowed at the source, so the result is complete. Rows arrive in no meaningful order unless sorted: whenever recency matters, sort by publishedAt (descending for newest or latest, ascending for oldest).
How many news articles The Bharat Times has published in total. Returns a single count, not the articles themselves.
The newspaper's sections (Politics, Business, World, Opinion, Culture, Sport). Use when the visitor asks what sections exist or wants content organised by section.
Short standalone facts the paper publishes as filler items — a line of text with an attribution. Use for 'tell me a fact' or trivia-style asks.
The paper's puzzles — crosswords and similar — with their type, difficulty and publication date. Use when the visitor asks what puzzles are available.
Reader polls the paper is running — the question and its options. Use when the visitor asks about polls or reader votes.
